_doc: The Frontier: an expansion continent across the sea from the Dragon Isle. Merged into gamedata.json by tools/build_data.py. Regions sit on their own 5x2 grid (realm 'frontier'); roads join grid neighbours, docks join the realms (sea_routes).

regions.name: Frostfang Coast
regions.about: A frozen shoreline where ice floes grind against the cliffs. Hardy fishers and breeders who trade in cold-blooded monsters keep the coast alive through the endless winter.

regions.name: Glacier Expanse
regions.about: A sea of ancient ice, cracked by blue crevasses that run deeper than any rope. Crystal-backed monsters roam the sheets, and travellers say the glacier hums at night.

regions.name: Rimeheart Peaks
regions.about: The roof of the Frontier: storm-wrapped summits around a frozen lake that never thaws. Only the strongest breeders climb the switchbacks to the Frostspire.

regions.name: Ashen Wastes
regions.about: Grey dunes of ash from fires that burned for a thousand years. Embers still glow in the cracks, and the creatures here feed on the heat beneath the dust.

regions.name: Infernal Rift
regions.about: Where the earth split open and the lava came up to meet the sky. Obsidian bridges cross rivers of fire, and the air tastes of brimstone.

regions.name: Elderwood
regions.about: A forest older than the kingdoms, its treetops so wide that whole villages shelter beneath a single bough. Mushroom rings mark the paths of forest spirits.

regions.name: Titanroot Forest
regions.about: Colossal trees whose roots form canyons. Glowing blue blossoms light the hollows, and the monsters here have grown as large as the trees that shelter them.

regions.name: Gravemoor
regions.about: A misty moor of endless graves. Lanterns burn on the crypt doors so the dead can find their way, and not every shape in the fog belongs to the living.

regions.name: Hollow Necropolis
regions.about: A city of tombs built for kings no one remembers. Giant bones jut from the dead ground and green light rises from the burial pits after dusk.

regions.name: Hellmouth
regions.about: A burning chasm ringed by black cliffs and demonic gates. Legends say the oldest dragons were born from its fire, and the strongest monsters in the world still prowl its rim.

towns.name: Icehaven
towns.about: A harbour town of turf-roofed lodges where ships from the Dragon Isle unload. Its Guild hall is warmed by a fire-drake kept in the cellar.

towns.name: Whitecap
towns.about: A fishing village on the cliffs, famous for hot fish stew and the ice-diving breeders who raise sea monsters in the frozen bays.

towns.name: Rimeholt
towns.about: A fortress-town carved into a wall of blue ice. Its people mine ice crystals that hold magic and trade them across the Frontier.

towns.name: Glacierfall
towns.about: A camp of snow-houses at the foot of a frozen waterfall, where glacier guides wait to lead travellers across the crevasses.

towns.name: Frostspire
towns.about: A monastery town clinging to the highest peak, where monks study the storms and train wind monsters in the thin air.

towns.name: Hoarfrost Hollow
towns.about: A hidden valley village around a hot spring, the only warm place for leagues. Breeders rest here before the final climb.

towns.name: Cinderreach
towns.about: A trading post built from the ribs of a fallen titan, where scavengers sell treasures dug from the ash.

towns.name: Ashfall
towns.about: A soot-black mining town where ash rains every evening. Its smiths forge gems in the heat of the fissures.

towns.name: Brimstone
towns.about: A fortress of obsidian on an island in a lava lake, home to fire-breeders who fear nothing.

towns.name: Emberhold
towns.about: A walled outpost guarding the bridges over the rift. Its watchmen have seen things crawl out of the lava that no Monsterpedia lists.

towns.name: Mossbrook
towns.about: A village of treehouses joined by rope bridges, where the elders speak with the forest and every child raises a sapling monster.

towns.name: Elderglen
towns.about: A glade town around a giant mushroom ring. Herbalists here brew potions from moss that only grows on thousand-year-old bark.

towns.name: Rootheart
towns.about: A town built inside the hollow trunk of a titan tree, lit by glowing blossoms. The Guild here is the oldest on the Frontier.

towns.name: Canopy Rise
towns.about: A lookout village high in the canopy, reached by lifts of woven vine. Flying monsters nest in its eaves.

towns.name: Gravesend
towns.about: The gravediggers' town at the edge of the moor. Its people are cheerful in the way only those who see the dead daily can be.

towns.name: Lanternwick
towns.about: A candle-makers' hamlet whose lanterns keep the restless dead away. Every door has a light, and every light has a name.

towns.name: Bonechapel
towns.about: A chapel-town built from tomb stones, where priests guard the necropolis and bind the spirits that wander out of it.

towns.name: Duskhallow
towns.about: A town that only wakes at nightfall. Its market sells relics, soul stones and stranger things.

towns.name: Pandemon
towns.about: A citadel of red stone on the rim of the Hellmouth, built by breeders mad enough to tame what lives inside it.

towns.name: Sulphur Gate
towns.about: The last town before the burning chasm: a gatehouse of iron and stone where the bravest breeders sign their names before descending.

dungeons.name: Frozen Labyrinth
dungeons.about: Tunnels melted through the glacier by something enormous. The walls are clear ice, and things are frozen inside them.

dungeons.name: Elder Hollow
dungeons.about: The hollow heart of the eldest titan tree, spiralling down through its roots into the earth.

dungeons.name: Crypt of Kings
dungeons.about: The royal crypt beneath the moor. Each floor holds an older dynasty, and the oldest kings do not rest.

dungeons.name: Ashen Catacombs
dungeons.about: Burial halls choked with ash, where the necropolis buried those who died in the great fire.

dungeons.name: Inferno Depths
dungeons.about: The descent into the Hellmouth itself. Few who go down the burning stairs come back, and none come back unchanged.
